name: Olive Oil
overview: Scripture reveals olive oil as a symbol of provision, blessing, and joy in the life of God's people. It was used practically in offerings and for lighting lamps to signify God's continual presence (Leviticus 2:5; 24:2), while also representing spiritual anointing and abundance, as seen in Psalms 23:5 and Matthew 6:17. Furthermore, Isaiah 61:3 connects olive oil with comfort and transformation, portraying it as the 'oil of joy' replacing mourning, underscoring God's power to renew and glorify His people.
